title: Clone Voices Instantly with the Tiny Audio8 TTS Model
description: Audio8 TTS is a lightweight 0.6B-parameter multilingual text-to-speech model with zero-shot voice cloning. It delivers state-of-the-art accuracy while using only a fraction of the hardware resources required by massive alternative models. Discover how to deploy it locally or serve it efficiently on your GPU.
